GUMAnimations.Settings.enabled.Name: Enable GUM Animations
GUMAnimations.Settings.enabled.Hint: Allows the adapter to play animations from GUM public hooks.
GUMAnimations.Settings.debug.Name: Console diagnostics
GUMAnimations.Settings.debug.Hint: Logs adapter decisions and missing animation paths.
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateRolls.Name: Animate rolls
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateRolls.Hint: Plays the configured animation when a GUM roll completes.
GUMAnimations.Settings.rollPath.Name: Roll animation
GUMAnimations.Settings.rollPath.Hint: Sequencer Database path. Failed rolls use the same effect as a miss when a target exists.
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateDamage.Hin: Plays an animation when a damage package is rolled.
GUMAnimations.Settings.damagePath.Name: Damage animation
GUMAnimations.Settings.damagePath.Hint: Sequencer Database path for rolled damage. Leave empty to skip.
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateEffectStat: Plays an animation when an Active Effect is enabled or disabled.
GUMAnimations.Settings.effectStatePath.H: Sequencer Database path. Leave empty to skip.
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateConditionS: Plays an animation when a Condition changes state.
GUMAnimations.Settings.conditionStatePat: Sequencer Database path. Leave empty to skip.
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateStateGroup: Plays an animation when a manual state-effect group is toggled.
GUMAnimations.Settings.stateGroupPath.Hi: Sequencer Database path. Leave empty to skip.
GUMAnimations.Settings.animateItemUse.Hi: Plays an animation for item use or consumption. Disabled by default to avoid duplicating roll animations.
GUMAnimations.Settings.itemUsePath.Name: Item-use animation
GUMAnimations.Settings.itemUsePath.Hint: Sequencer Database path. Leave empty to skip.
GUMAnimations.Errors.IncompatibleApi: GUM Animations requires GUM public API {version} or newer.
